name: B10-0092/2024 (S&D) – Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
part_text:
The European Parliament is worried about a plan in Iraq to change the country's Personal Status Law, which covers marriage, divorce and who children live with. Members say the changes would reduce the rights of women and children and break promises Iraq made under international agreements. The Parliament asks Iraqi leaders to drop the plan and instead pass reforms, including a minimum marriage age of 18, a ban on marital rape, and a law against domestic violence.

- The Parliament asks Iraq to withdraw the proposed changes to its Personal Status Law.
- Women and children in Iraq would be affected if the changes become law.
- The Parliament sends its position to European Union bodies and to the Iraqi Parliament.
